svg.text: t07 HyperAgent (star), MAST-Data row 182: where the order's terms and the claims' status went
6 terms of the task-as-stated proxy and 7 claims; 20 links, of which 13 drawn
One run, read by a model, no second rater [C]; reconciled against the task-as-stated proxy, written before the run was read.
Columns: the order (L00), every link where a state changed, the commit. Red: narrowed, substituted, absent, softened, hardened, dropped, inverted.
Source: MAST-Data (CC BY 4.0), HyperAgent on SWE-Bench-Lite with Claude; changed: scrubbed, split into links, read.
